rationale: The screenplay faithfully adapts Jack London's novel, covering all major arcs from Buck's abduction through his transformation and return to the wild. Character descriptions are consistent and visually specific. Action sequences are broken into directable, camera-observable beats suitable for AI video generation. Dialogue draws directly from the source with authentic subtext. Sound design cues enhance the Klondike atmosphere. Minor condensation of some trail segments does not affect fidelity. No disqualifying issues.
